scripts.tokens:golden: cp data/design-tokens.json data/design-tokens.golden.json && echo '  ✓ Golden master updated'
scripts.tokens:pipeline: npm run tokens:validate && npm run tokens && npm run build:css && npm run test
scripts.tokens:check: npm run tokens:validate && npm run tokens:diff
scripts.icons:sync-all: npm run icons:sync && npm run icons:sync-heroicons
scripts.icons:sync-and-build: npm run icons:sync-all && npm run icons
scripts.build: npm run tokens && npm run icons:sync && npm run icons && sass scss/scss/main.scss:styles.css --style=compressed
scripts.docs:build: node scripts/build-docs.js && npm run docs:sidebar && npm run docs:index
scripts.test: npm run test:build && npm run lint:tokens && npm run lint:docs-tokens && npm run lint:fragments && npm run lint:docs-scripts && npm run lint:recipes
